criteria.ego_lane: lane or lane connector under the rear axle (on-route first, then lowest heading error < 90 deg); successors until >= lookahead_m lie ahead of the ego (on-route first, then most logged future ego positions inside, then smallest mean distance to them)
criteria.gap: arc length along the lane-chain centreline from the ego front bumper to the nearest box corner
criteria.strip: lane-chain centreline buffered by the ego half width (flat caps)
criteria.first_in_path: no other path_blockers box (any speed) intersects the strip nearer than the target, now
criteria.target: nearest qualifying vehicle wholly inside the lane chain, then strip fraction >= min_strip_fraction

criteria.injection: v = gap / h, gap = route-centerline arc length from the front bumper to the target's current footprint; velocity [v, 0] x 4, acceleration 0, four past poses v x 0.5 s apart along the route centerline, or straight back along the ego heading when the ego is > 2 m or > 15 deg off it (history_frame)
criteria.hit: non-reacting plan: constant v along the route centerline, ego footprint vs the recorded target box at 0.1 s steps over 4 s
